notes.title: Competition Announcement
notes.notes:
[i]We are happy to announce our first competition for The Worst Game Ever. Simply record a video of your gameplay that shows you completing the game, from start to finish. The first 20 valid submissions will be entered into the competition and the participant with the fastest completion of the game will win $100!

In order to enter, record a video of your successful gameplay (via YouTube or Twitch), then submit your video recording to sleepysheep.dev@gmail.com.

Use of cheats, exploits, video time editing, or any other form of tampering is prohibited. Each video will be thoroughly reviewed. This competition will end when we receive at least 20 valid submissions. You will be contacted if your video is qualified for entry.[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.notes:
[i]After gathering substantial feedback from beta testers as well as friends, I've decided to improve the gameplay. After all, The Worst Game Ever is meant to be hard but it doesn't mean it needs to be unenjoyable. 

Thus, I've decided to make Normal mode easier. I've improved the general level and adjusted/added platforms for easier travel. The significant "improvement" is that now, in Normal mode, rotating (gold) objects are being reset after each fall, thus making it easier to restart from the beginning.

I've also added a few grappling objects in the "Death Valley" (mid section of the game). You'll know what I mean once you get there. It'll help you pass the valley but you'll have to account your timing.

Finish line is still pretty tough to get to, but it's doable. Just remember using physics to your advantage.

Hardcore mode will remain hardcore and will be improved upon next couple updates. I just need more feedback to create a doable hardcore level, so please leave as much feedback as possible.

For the next couple of days I will be releasing a few patch updates to fix remain bugs and what not. Once the baseline is done, my plan is to begin working on multiplayer / co-op. I believe that would be an exciting update for everyone. 

As always, thank you very much for giving this game a go. Good luck!

[/i]

notes.title: Public Beta Test
notes.notes:
We are looking for players to test the game and give feedback before its release. If you're interested, hop on the train! In order to participate, please go through an "application" process:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1409520/discussions/0/3001051775897027062/

Most likely everyone will get accepted, as this game runs even on potato PC's due it's simplicity and optimization. For everyone who's going to participate, we'll include extra cd-keys for your friends on the release date.

Thank you everyone in advance!
- Sleepy Speep.
